arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly customs net receipts for 1974 (in millions)
values = [309, 247, 285, 294, 309, 311, 332, 364, 312, 355, 326, 316]

n = len(values)

# Mean
mean = sum(values) / n

# Population variance (using N, not N-1)
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n

# Population standard deviation
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

# Coefficient of variation
cv = (std_dev / mean) * 100

print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"N = {n}")
print(f"Sum = {sum(values)}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")
print(f"Population variance = {variance}")
print(f"Population std dev = {std_dev}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation = {cv}%")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(cv, 2)}%")
EOF
